# Custom Fields

## Documentation Sets

- [Custom Fields](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/llms-full.txt)

## Landing

- [Custom Fields - Dynamic Fields Without Migrations](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2): Add dynamic custom fields to your Filament admin panels without writing database migrations. Perfect for multi-tenant SaaS and admin panels.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/getting-started/installation): Get started with Custom Fields in just a few steps
- [Quickstart](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/getting-started/quickstart): Get Custom Fields v2 working in your Filament project in under 5 minutes
- [Upgrade Guide](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/getting-started/upgrade-guide): Learn how to upgrade your Custom Fields from version 1 to version 2
- [Configuration](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/configuration): Configure all aspects of the Custom Fields package
- [Authorization](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/authorization): Control access to the Custom Fields management interface
- [Field Types](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/field-types): Built-in field types and how to create custom ones
- [Preset Custom Fields](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/preset-custom-fields): Programmatically define and deploy custom fields using migrations
- [Import/Export](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/import-export): Learn how to import and export custom field data with import/export actions
- [Data Model](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/essentials/data-model): Understanding the Custom Fields database architecture
- [Support](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/community/support): Get help with Custom Fields
- [Contributing](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/community/contributing): How to contribute to Custom Fields
- [License](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/community/license): Dual-licensed under AGPL-3.0 for open source and commercial licenses for private applications
- [Code Distribution](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/v2/community/code-distribution): Guidelines for distributing Custom Fields code
